workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The approved Beat Plan has multiple beats, but the movement can be realized as one structured artifact unless a medium plan accepts cumulative expansion.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

story_structure.name: Freytag Dramatic Arc
story_structure.core_movement: An obsolete fire lookout tower becomes dramatically necessary during a dry lightning storm, reaches a peak when the lookout sends an unverified warning, then falls through consequence into mixed residue rather than triumph.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The rehearsal compresses Freytag into five Beat Plan beats: exposition/exciting force, rising action, climax, falling action, and denouement. It gives the falling side real emotional weight instead of treating it as explanation.
story_structure.turn_logic: The audience first expects a human-versus-automation validation arc, then the climax turns into a consequence arc where being right still causes harm.
story_structure.compression_rule: Merge exposition with exciting force, give rising action one strong pressure build, then preserve separate climax, falling action, and denouement beats so consequence is not skipped.
story_structure.expansion_rule: If expanded, split the rising side into repeated sensor/human perception conflicts and split the falling side into saved ridge, stranded crew, public accounting, and decommissioning residue.
failure_modes: the climax validates the hero and leaves no governing change
falling action summarizes consequences instead of making the audience sit with them
the rise uses emergency volume rather than moral pressure
the ending ties off plot while avoiding mixed emotional residue

beats.one_move_summary: The lookout begins her final week in a tower everyone treats as obsolete until a dry lightning storm makes the valley feel newly vulnerable.
beats.before_state: The tower is scheduled for automation and the lookout's attention is treated as sentimental redundancy.
beats.after_state: The storm makes obsolescence feel dangerous rather than settled.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A decommissioned tower suggests a quiet retirement or nostalgia story.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The dry lightning storm turns the old tower into the only human vantage point still watching.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The exciting force starts the dramatic line without yet proving the lookout right.

beats.intended_feeling: uneasy attention inside something everyone else has dismissed
beats.emotional_payload: The old lookout system may still see what the faster system misses.

tension_profile.name: Obsolescence / Perception
tension_profile.emotional_function: turns the tower's age into a live source of pressure

tension_profile.name: Calm / Threat
tension_profile.emotional_function: lets the storm disturb the final-week stillness

source_evidence: The lookout spends the last week in a mountain tower scheduled for automation during dry lightning conditions.

pivot_options.label: rising-pressure
pivot_options.next_move: Let the lookout see smoke that the sensors mark clear.
pivot_options.rationale: The rise needs pressure between human attention and automated certainty.

traceability_notes.note: The opening merges exposition and exciting force as Freytag compression guidance allows.

beats.one_move_summary: The lookout sees smoke in a ravine the sensors call clear, and each minute of hesitation increases the cost of trusting either system.
beats.before_state: Human attention and automated certainty can still coexist uneasily.
beats.after_state: The lookout must choose because waiting becomes its own risk.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The sensor system should resolve uncertainty faster than the lookout can.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The discrepancy widens and makes both obedience and warning dangerous.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The rise builds moral pressure rather than just emergency spectacle.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Clarity increases fear instead of reducing it.

beats.intended_feeling: the tightening pressure of needing to act before certainty arrives
beats.emotional_payload: The rise is the cost of attention when authority disagrees.

tension_profile.name: Attention / Certainty
tension_profile.emotional_function: forces the dramatic climb toward a choice

tension_profile.name: Obedience / Responsibility
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes protocol feel both protective and dangerous

source_evidence: She spots smoke in a ravine the sensors have marked clear.

pivot_options.label: send-warning
pivot_options.next_move: The lookout breaks protocol by sending the unverified warning.
pivot_options.rationale: Freytag requires the strongest pressure to change the governing condition.

traceability_notes.note: The rising action protects pressure as a moral decision, not volume.

beats.one_move_summary: She sends the unverified warning, saving one ridge and immediately changing the story from whether she is right to what her rightness costs.
beats.before_state: The central question is whether she should trust what she sees.
beats.after_state: The central condition changes: action has happened and consequence is now unavoidable.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The warning should function as the triumphant proof that human attention matters.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The warning saves one ridge while beginning the chain that strands a crew.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The climax changes direction from validation to accounting.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Relief is immediately contaminated by dread.

beats.intended_feeling: the shock of a necessary action becoming morally irreversible
beats.emotional_payload: The peak does not end the pressure; it changes what kind of pressure the story is about.

tension_profile.name: Necessity / Harm
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the climax change the governing condition

tension_profile.name: Relief / Dread
tension_profile.emotional_function: prevents the peak from becoming simple triumph

source_evidence: She breaks protocol by sending an unverified warning, causing an evacuation that saves one ridge but strands a crew.

pivot_options.label: falling-consequence
pivot_options.next_move: Follow the stranded crew and saved ridge as consequence, not summary.
pivot_options.rationale: Freytag needs the falling action to matter as much as the climb.

traceability_notes.note: The climax answers the rise by changing the governing condition of the work.

beats.one_move_summary: After the evacuation, the saved ridge and stranded crew make the valley count the same warning as rescue and harm.
beats.before_state: The warning has proven the lookout's perception mattered.
beats.after_state: The warning becomes ethically mixed because its consequences cannot be separated.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: After a correct warning, the falling action should confirm her judgment.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The aftermath forces everyone to weigh saved lives against people endangered by the warning's timing.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: Consequence replaces escalation and keeps the story morally open.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Gratitude and blame occupy the same event.

beats.intended_feeling: the heavy stillness after a right choice that still hurt people
beats.emotional_payload: The falling side is where the work refuses clean vindication.

tension_profile.name: Vindication / Accountability
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the aftermath from becoming summary

source_evidence: The evacuation saves one ridge but strands a crew on the old access road.

pivot_options.label: denouement
pivot_options.next_move: Let the tower still be decommissioned while the lookout sits with the mixed residue.
pivot_options.rationale: The final state should land the emotional wound rather than solve the plot.

traceability_notes.note: The falling action preserves consequence after necessary choice as the piece's core meaning.

beats.one_move_summary: The tower is decommissioned anyway, leaving the lookout with saved lives, stranded people, and no clean verdict.
beats.before_state: The aftermath might still become public vindication or institutional reversal.
beats.after_state: The final state preserves mixed residue: the tower ends, the warning mattered, and harm remains.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The institution might keep the tower after the lookout proves its value.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The tower is still decommissioned, and the moral residue stays with the lookout.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The denouement refuses structural reward while preserving emotional consequence.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Release is paired with unresolved burden.

beats.intended_feeling: the sober residue of being necessary without being absolved
beats.emotional_payload: The ending lands the wound rather than the verdict.

tension_profile.name: Closure / Wound
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the final state emotionally open

tension_profile.name: Usefulness / Obsolescence
tension_profile.emotional_function: lets the tower's value and ending coexist

source_evidence: After the fire passes, the tower is still decommissioned.

traceability_notes.note: The denouement preserves necessary action without absolution.

tension_points.summary: The warning is necessary and harmful at the same time.
tension_points.intended_feeling: moral residue after an urgent correct choice
tension_points.emotional_payload: Being right does not erase what the action caused.
source_evidence: The warning saves one ridge but strands a crew.

traceability_notes.note: The tension point protects consequence after necessary choice.
The opening combines exposition and exciting force.
The rise builds pressure to choose before certainty arrives.
The climax changes the governing condition from whether to act to what the action caused.
The falling movement keeps consequence emotionally active.
The final movement lands mixed residue rather than reward.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Rise from dismissed human attention toward an irreversible warning, then fall through consequence so aftermath matters as much as escalation.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: A lower adjacent shift can be waived only if the artist explicitly wants a quieter dramatic arc and the climax still changes the governing condition.

adjacent_beat_shifts.shift_summary: The tower's latent pressure becomes an urgent choice between human attention and automated certainty.
The pressure peaks when the lookout acts and the governing condition changes from uncertainty to consequence.
After the peak, escalation gives way to rescue/harm accounting.
The consequence settles into unresolved residue when institutional reward does not arrive.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if the climax only validates the lookout, if falling action becomes recap, or if the denouement resolves the mixed residue too cleanly.

arc_summary.beginning: The obsolete tower becomes dramatically live during a dry lightning storm.
arc_summary.turn: The lookout sends the unverified warning, changing the story from whether she is right to what her rightness costs.
arc_summary.ending_or_residue: The tower is decommissioned anyway, and the lookout carries saved lives, stranded people, and no clean verdict.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: A Freytag arc is appropriate because the piece needs visible rise, peak turn, falling consequence, and final residue.

traceability_summary.note: The Beat Plan adapts the invented reference's obsolete tower, storm pressure, warning climax, stranded crew consequence, and decommissioning residue.
The adapted Freytag arc preserves consequence after necessary choice.
Freytag guides rise, peak turn, falling action, and denouement without choosing medium, output shape, asset count, or Cultural Format Structure.
